+<<<
+==== PACK
+
+===== Mnemonic
+
+pack _rd_, _rs1_, _rs2_
+
+===== Encoding
+
+PACK is encoded in the OP major opcode.
+
+[wavedrom, ,svg]
+....
+{reg:[
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x33, attr: ['OP'] },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rd' },
+    { bits: 3, name: 0x4 },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs1' },
+    { bits: 5, name: 'rs2' },
+    { bits: 7, name: 0x4, attr: ['PACK'] },
+]}
+....
+
+===== Description
+
+The pack instruction packs the XLEN/2-bit lower halves of `rs1` and `rs2` into
+`rd`, with `rs1` in the lower half and `rs2` in the upper half.
+
+===== Operation
+
+[source,pseudocode]
+----
+s1 = X[rs1]
+s2 = X[rs2]
+
+d = s2[XLEN/2-1:0] @ s1[XLEN/2-1:0]
+
+X[rd] = d
+----
+
